invariants.rationale: The method calls file.parent() immediately, so file must not be null to avoid NullPointerException.
A new StringTokenizer(path, ...) is constructed, so path must be non-null for correct tokenization.
The result variable is initialized as file.parent(); if file.parent() returns null, subsequent .parent() or .child() calls may throw an exception.
String.length() is always non-negative; this checks structural property of path as a String.
If path is empty, tokenizer will have no elements, so result will be file.parent().
